paragraphs: Today, we announced our fourth quarter 2025 earnings, marking a strong finish to the year with exceptional user growth and continued momentum across the business.
Premium Subscribers grew 10% Y/Y to 290 million
Monthly Active Users (MAUs) climbed 11% Y/Y to 751 million
Total Revenue increased 13% Y/Y constant currency* to €4.5 billion

Q4 2025 delivered the highest MAU net adds in Spotify history, reaching 751 million monthly active users, and achieving double-digit subscriber growth. We remain focused on offering extraordinary value for users, while solving problems for creators, artists, authors and the industries they serve. Take a look at this quarter’s highlights below:

Celebrating Our Biggest. Wrapped. Ever. Our 11th annual Wrapped was bigger, bolder, and more layered than ever, celebrating fans, artists, creators, and authors around the world. At the end of the campaign, Wrapped had more than 300 million engaged users and more than 630 million shares on social media globally in 56 languages.
translations: Spotify 表示，2025 年第四季度表现强劲，用户增长突出，业务保持增长势头。
Premium 订阅用户同比增长 10%，达到 2.9 亿。
月活跃用户同比增长 11%，达到 7.51 亿。
按固定汇率计算，总营收同比增长 13%，达到 45 亿欧元。
2025 年第四季度，Spotify 的月活跃用户净增数创历史新高，达到 7.51 亿，订阅用户也实现两位数增长。公司继续专注于为用户提供价值，同时解决创作者、艺术家、作者及其所在行业的问题。
Spotify 第 11 届 Wrapped 活动在全球 56 种语言中覆盖了 3 亿多名活跃用户，并在社交媒体上获得超过 6.3 亿次分享。
fullTextParagraphs: Today, we announced our fourth quarter 2025 earnings, marking a strong finish to the year with exceptional user growth and continued momentum across the business.

Daniel Ek, Founder and Executive Chairman, said: “Today, what we’ve really built is a technology platform for audio—and increasingly, for all the ways creators connect with audiences. And this identity will matter even more going forward. The next wave of technology shifts—AI, new interfaces, wearables, new ways of interacting with content—these will reshape how people discover and experience audio and media. The hard problems ahead—in music, in podcasts, in books, in video, in live, and in things we haven’t built yet—we’re going to keep building the technology to solve them.”

Alex Norström, Co-CEO, said: “We closed out what we dubbed as the Year of Accelerated Execution with another solid quarter, delivering a strong finish to 2025. In Q4, we met or exceeded guidance across all key metrics. We marked our highest quarter ever for MAU net additions. It’s incredible to think that we now serve over three quarters of a billion people around the world…We’re framing 2026 as the Year of Raising Ambition. We were founded to solve what felt like the impossible, and ambition has been the driving force behind our success from our earliest days. And ambition will be a guiding principle of our next chapter.”

Gustav Söderström, Co-CEO, said: “We consider ourselves the R&D department for the music industry. Our job is to understand new technologies quickly and capture their potential, which we’ve done time and again. The entire industry stands to benefit from this [AI] paradigm shift but we believe those who embrace this change and move fast, will benefit the most.”
Premium Subscribers grew 10% Y/Y to 290 million
Monthly Active Users (MAUs) climbed 11% Y/Y to 751 million
Total Revenue increased 13% Y/Y constant currency* to €4.5 billion
Gross Margin improved by 83 bps Y/Y to 33.1%
Operating Income reached €701 million

Q4 2025 delivered the highest MAU net adds in Spotify history, reaching 751 million monthly active users, and achieving double-digit subscriber growth. We remain focused on offering extraordinary value for users, while solving problems for creators, artists, authors and the industries they serve. Take a look at this quarter’s highlights below:

Celebrating Our Biggest. Wrapped. Ever. Our 11th annual Wrapped was bigger, bolder, and more layered than ever, celebrating fans, artists, creators, and authors around the world. At the end of the campaign, Wrapped had more than 300 million engaged users and more than 630 million shares on social media globally in 56 languages.

Prompted Playlist Puts Listeners in Control. Prompted Playlist lets Premium users in select markets describe exactly what they want to hear using their own words, putting meaningful control of the algorithm directly in their hands.
Search and Follow Your Favorite Venues. Listeners can now follow their favorite venues, discover new spots nearby, and explore upcoming lineups, all without leaving the app.

Ed Sheeran Brings Billions Club Live to Dublin. Ed Sheeran brought Billions Club Live to Dublin with a one-night-only performance, playing for 1,700 top fans. Listeners everywhere can now experience the show, available exclusively on Spotify.

Audiobooks in Premium Expands To Five New Countries. Audiobooks in Premium are now available in Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Iceland, and Monaco, giving eligible subscribers access to hundreds of thousands of titles alongside music and podcasts.
Audiobook Recaps: An Audio Bookmark That Speaks. Audiobook Recaps help listeners jump back into stories with short, personalized summaries, covering the portion of the book they’ve already heard.

Page Match: Moving Seamlessly Between Physical and Audiobook. Page Match connects physical, e-books, and audiobooks into a single, continuous experience. Readers can scan a page of a printed or e-book and continue the story in the audiobook on Spotify at the moment they left off. Later this spring, users in the U.S. and U.K. can purchase physical books through the Spotify app via a new partnership with Bookshop.org, whose model directly supports independent bookstores.

$11B Paid Out To The Music Industry In 2025. In 2025, we paid out more than $11 billion to the music industry, the largest annual payment to music creators from any retailer in history, with independent artists and labels accounting for half of all royalties. We also helped artists generate more than $1 billion in ticket sales by connecting fans with live shows through our ticketing partners.
Spotify Partner Program Expands to the Nordics. The Spotify Partner Program expanded to Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Iceland, unlocking new ways for creators to earn, grow, and connect with fans.

Music Videos Expand in Beta. Music videos in beta are rolling out to Premium users in the U.S. and Canada, giving fans access to a growing catalog of official videos, from studio releases to live performances and covers.

FC Barcelona Partnership Extended Through 2030. The partnership with FC Barcelona is extended through 2030, continuing a collaboration that brings music, sport, and culture together for fans around the world.

Tunetorials Bring Advertising Strategies to Life. Tunetorials is a new campaign that turns proven advertising strategies into original songs and music videos, blending education and entertainment to help advertisers reach the right audience at the right moment.
Read the full earnings release here and listen to the webcast Q&A on our Investor Relations site here.
*Constant currency adjusted measures are non-IFRS measures. See reconciliation of IFRS to non-IFRS results below for additional information.

notes.phrase: Premium Subscribers grew 10% Y/Y to 290 million
notes.meaning: 高级订阅用户同比增长 10%，达到 2.9 亿
notes.explain: grew to 说明增长后的规模；Y/Y 表示同比。
notes.example: Premium subscribers grew 8% year over year to 3.1 million.

notes.phrase: Monthly Active Users (MAUs) climbed 11% Y/Y to 751 million
notes.meaning: 月活跃用户同比增长 11%，达到 7.51 亿
notes.explain: climbed to 说明指标升至新的数值。
notes.example: Monthly active users climbed 6% year over year to 22 million.

notes.phrase: more than 630 million shares on social media globally
notes.meaning: 全球社交媒体分享超过 6.3 亿次

scenario.title: 向管理层汇报品牌活动表现
english: A campaign reached 12 million users and generated 2.4 million shares.
The company’s active customer base grew 8% year over year, while revenue rose 5%.
Write a short update that separates audience, engagement, and revenue measures.
chinese: 一项活动触达 1200 万用户，并产生 240 万次分享。
公司活跃客户数同比增长 8%，营收增长 5%。
请写一条简短更新，分别说明受众规模、互动和营收指标。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请给营销团队写三句话：报告 Spotify 的用户和营收指标，补充一个活动结果，并说明公司继续关注什么。
firstAttempt.sample: Spotify ended Q4 2025 with 751 million monthly active users, up 11% year over year. Revenue increased 13% to EUR 4.5 billion on a constant-currency basis, while Wrapped generated more than 630 million social shares. The company remains focused on user value and supporting creators.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先交代核心规模和增长，再用活动数据补充，最后点明业务重点。

structure.original: Total Revenue increased 13% Y/Y constant currency* to €4.5 billion
analysis: increased 13% Y/Y 交代变化幅度与比较期间。
constant currency 是统计口径，正式汇报时要保留。
structure.transfer: Revenue increased 5% year over year on a constant-currency basis.

rewrite.bad: Spotify had a great year. Lots of people shared Wrapped.
rewrite.good: Spotify ended Q4 2025 with 751 million monthly active users, up 11% year over year. Revenue increased 13% to EUR 4.5 billion on a constant-currency basis, while Wrapped generated more than 630 million social shares. The company remains focused on user value and supporting creators.
rewrite.translation: Spotify 在 2025 年第四季度末拥有 7.51 亿月活跃用户，同比增长 11%。按固定汇率计算，营收增长 13%，达到 45 亿欧元；Wrapped 活动带来超过 6.3 亿次社交媒体分享。公司继续关注用户价值，并支持创作者。
rewrite.pattern: [Metric] reached [number], up [x] year over year. Revenue increased [x] on a [basis], while [campaign] generated [engagement]. We remain focused on [priority].

translationPractice.answer: Monthly active users climbed 11% year over year.
translationPractice.why: 用 year over year 比较本季度与去年同期的月活跃用户。

translationPractice.prompt: 按固定汇率计算，营收增长 13%。
translationPractice.answer: Revenue increased 13% on a constant-currency basis.
translationPractice.why: 保留 constant-currency basis，说明汇率影响已剔除。

translationPractice.prompt: Wrapped 活动获得超过 6.3 亿次社交媒体分享。
translationPractice.answer: Wrapped generated more than 630 million social shares.
translationPractice.why: generated shares 报告活动带来的分享次数，不等同于购买或用户数。

choice.prompt: 公告要报告营收增长，同时说明汇率影响已剔除，哪种说法准确？
options: Revenue rose by 13% in every market.
Revenue increased 13% on a constant-currency basis.
choice.why: 第二句保留原文指标及固定汇率口径，没有推断利润或各市场表现。

output.prompt: 某品牌季度活动触达 12 million 人、获得 2.4 million 次分享；活跃客户同比增长 8%，固定汇率营收同比增长 5%。请写三句话给营销负责人汇报。
output.sample: The campaign reached 12 million people and generated 2.4 million shares. Active customers grew 8% year over year. Revenue increased 5% on a constant-currency basis, so we should review engagement and commercial results separately.
check: 区分触达人数与分享次数
报告活跃客户同比变化
保留固定汇率营收口径
